change: r5 prescribes 1. Ke7 Kc8 2. Ne5 from 8/2k5/5K2/3B4/2N5/8/8/8, with D4 symmetry

method.patch:
diff --git a/app/src/mate/rules/bishopKnightPreparation.ts b/app/src/mate/rules/bishopKnightPreparation.ts
index 3a43ad4..70aeb4f 100644
--- a/app/src/mate/rules/bishopKnightPreparation.ts
+++ b/app/src/mate/rules/bishopKnightPreparation.ts
@@ -1,4 +1,14 @@
-// r5 is intentionally empty. New declarations can be added here later.
-export function knightAndBishopDeclaredPreparationMove(_fen: string): string | undefined {
-  return undefined
+import { SQUARE_TRANSFORMS, transformFen, transformSquare } from '../chess'
+
+// Exact r5 declarations; counters do not affect placement. All earlier rules retain priority.
+const declarations = new Map(([
+  ['8/2k5/5K2/3B4/2N5/8/8/8 w - - 0 1', 'f6', 'e7'],
+  ['2k5/4K3/8/3B4/2N5/8/8/8 w - - 2 2', 'c4', 'e5'],
+] as const).flatMap(([fen, from, to]) => SQUARE_TRANSFORMS.map(transform => [
+  transformFen(fen, transform).split(' ').slice(0, 2).join(' '),
+  transformSquare(from, transform) + transformSquare(to, transform),
+] as const)))
+
+export function knightAndBishopDeclaredPreparationMove(fen: string): string | undefined {
+  return declarations.get(fen.split(' ').slice(0, 2).join(' '))
 }
method.verification: Rebuilding the prior empty r5 module produces a byte-identical reference worker to the exhaustive baseline. Only the two exact declaration orbits can change White policy. Every new edge resolves to an existing full-census node.
